risks.title: Raw material and energy price risk
risks.score_rationale: Raw material (especially scrap) and energy price risk is presented as a major risk. Rapid fluctuations in scrap prices can compress margins if the company cannot immediately pass through cost increases to selling prices. This impact is particularly strong during periods of weak demand.

risks.title: Global steel production overcapacity risk
risks.score_rationale: Global steel production overcapacity is estimated at approximately 704 million net tons in 2025, or eight times the current annual production of the United States. China produces over 1 billion tons and exports a record 131 million tons, creating intense competitive pressure.

risks.title: Tariff circumvention risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk of tariff circumvention remains present, with a growing trend of China building new steel capacity in other countries (Southeast Asia, Africa) to avoid tariffs.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Approximately 24% of Nucor's long-term debt is variable rate (primarily weekly-resetting IDRs), with the remainder fixed rate (76%). Future changes in interest rates are not expected to have a significant impact on results. Nucor also occasionally uses interest rate swaps to manage exposure.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Nucor operates primarily in North America and the majority of its customers and facilities are located in North America, limiting exposure to foreign exchange risk.
